proposal.hypothesis: The earlier explicit-shuffle and native-warp-reduction candidates both passed the displayed cases and had repeated reported means below baseline, but those full-program results do not establish that the local tree caused the difference. This contrasting variant retains shuffle reduction within each warp and tests whether a lane-0 serial combine of four warp totals is preferable to a second warp reduction.

retained: Replace the modulo/shared-memory tree with a five-step warp shuffle reduction, one shared unsigned partial per warp, and a lane-0 serial sum of the four warp totals.

Use unsigned modulo-2^32 arithmetic for all reduction stages; map each stored residue to an in-range signed int via a 64-bit intermediate so conversion is defined, and recover the residue by the standard signed-to-unsigned modulo conversion on the next stage.
Retain zero-filled tail handling, 128-thread blocks, recursive host launches, scratch-bank offsets, ABI, and default-stream ordering; asynchronously zero the output for n<=0.
